from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
base=Path('analysis')/sys.argv[1]
with base.with_suffix('.stdout.jsonl').open('x') as out, base.with_suffix('.stderr.log').open('x') as err:
    result=subprocess.run(sys.argv[2:], stdout=out, stderr=err)
print(f'{base}: exit {result.returncode}')
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
